author: ReluctantGamer
quote:
The video game equivalent of the girl who comes into your sandbox to tell you you're playing wrong, and when you tell on her, the adults tell YOU to play nice.

The girl who thinks she's superior to you simply because no one has ever challenged that notion for her. You shoot a cop. "Good boy." You TRY to shoot an LGBT protestor. "Bad boy. You're playing wrong."

It's almost not even a video game, in the sense that games are made to be played. It feels like it was made to be hated, so they could take the high road on it. It's like some weird social experiment.

Rockstar used to give players the freedom to play how they wanted. These people pretending to be Rockstar only give you enough freedom to pretend like you're not being mind-controlled.

Guys, don't peel the orange. If she wants an orange, she can do it herself.
